propositions: Task and story both children of same epic cannot hold direct blocking dependency; resolved pair escalates incorrectly to epic-to-child, violating hierarchy invariant
Blocking link comparability should key on parent hierarchy structure, not on ticket type tier, so cross-subtree dependencies escalate to nearest common ancestor children
Redundancy guard evaluated before promotion rejects original pair but misses promoted pair; widened predicate evaluated post-resolution catches ancestor-descendant cases missed before
Ancestor walk capped at max_hops=2 truncates chains deeper than epic-story-task and feeds chain-root fallback causing incorrect escalation
Virtual root sentinel ensures every ticket chain has defined common ancestor with disjoint trees, eliminating undefined disjoint case
